q: How do I calculate an eye hospital's carbon footprint per surgery?
title: Eye hospital CO2 per surgery
short: Add theatre and clinic electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, generator diesel and sterilisation, then divide by surgeries. Single use kits, lenses and drugs are Scope 3 and can match or exceed the energy. Report outpatient visits separately from surgeries.
audience: Eye hospitals and cataract surgery centres

ul: Purchases of surgical kits, intraocular lenses and drapes.

p: Compare per surgery: reusable instruments add sterilisation energy, single use kits add purchased goods and waste.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
